title: tests.py fails on a compile warning in any tool or test file
goal: Before pytest runs, tests.py compiles every _tools/*.py in-process with warnings raised as errors (writing no .pyc) and exits non-zero naming each file and line whose compile warns, such as an invalid escape sequence (a SyntaxWarning, a DeprecationWarning on older Pythons); the clean tree still passes, and maintaining.md, code.md and tools.md say so.

notes: Premise (2026-10-07): tests.py has no compile step; a planted unimported tool file holding an invalid escape passes (exit 0), and a planted test file holding one only prints the warning.
